title: Daily Dose #367: Not Ashamed of the Gospel
body:
**“For I am not ashamed of the gospel, for it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes.”**

The gospel is the good news that Jesus Christ died for sinners and rose again, offering forgiveness and new life to those who trust Him.

It is not advice for people who already have life under control. It is news of rescue for people who cannot save themselves.

Paul was not ashamed because the power belonged to God. He did not need to make the message fashionable or hide its difficult parts. He spoke truth with confidence in the One who saves.

Do not be rude, defensive or eager for conflict. But do not hide Jesus to protect your image. The gospel needs no apology and no decoration.
